answer: Each submission hangs on the willow of a task receipt, and the relic is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the sonnet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
